Description: Infection of susceptible individuals at force of infection λ(t) = β * I(t)/N
Progression through first exposed sub-compartment at rate σ
Progression from exposed to infectious at rate σ
Progression through first infectious sub-compartment at rate γ

Name: σ
Description: Daily rate of transition between exposed sub-compartments (E1 to E2 and E2 to I1), leading to average incubation period dL = 2/σ days

Name: γ
Description: Daily rate of transition between infectious sub-compartments (I1 to I2 and I2 to R), leading to average infectious period dI = 2/γ days

Name: π
Description: Proportion of the population who are initially susceptible (susceptibility)

Name: λ0
Description: Initial infection rate

Name: ψ
Description: Exponential growth rate (EGR) at which compartments E1, E2, I1, I2 grow initially

Name: η
Description: Over-dispersion parameter of the Negative Binomial observation model

Name: pICU
Description: Probability of ICU/HDU admission given infection

Name: µICU|E
Description: Mean time from infection to ICU admission (Gamma distributed waiting time)

Name: σ2ICU|E
Description: Variance of time from infection to ICU admission

Name: β
Description: Transmission rate (rate at which new infections take place given a contact)

Name: R0
Description: Basic reproduction number, average number of successful transmissions per infectious person in a fully susceptible population

Name: Rn
Description: Effective reproduction number, average number of successful transmissions per infectious person in a partially susceptible population

Name: δt
Description: Discrete time step length (quarter of a day)

Name: N2012/13
Description: Population size for 2012/13 season

Name: N2013/14
Description: Population size for 2013/14 season

Name: N2014/15
Description: Population size for 2014/15 season
